title: 考研英语一应用文小作文全题型实用句式库 (Practical Writing Patterns)
description: 系统梳理考研英语一小作文（满分10分，约100词）全部核心文体：Notice告示、Memo备忘录、Proposal倡议书、推荐信、建议信、邀请信、感谢/道歉信高分框架与实战句型

notice.name: 告示与通知 (Notice / Announcement)
notice.format_features: 标题 NOTICE 居中；正文首段发布事由；次段交代时间、地点、资格、流程；尾段注明咨询途径；署名单位在右下方，绝不写 Dear 也不写 Li Ming 个人名义（通常署名 The Students' Union 或 Postgraduates' Association）
opening_patterns: Notice is hereby given that [活动名称] is scheduled to be held from [时间] to [时间] at [地点].
We are immensely pleased to announce that a grand [活动名称] will be launched by [主办单位] next month.
In an effort to [活动目的，如: enrich campus cultural life], an exciting [活动名称] is about to take place.
body_patterns: All postgraduate and undergraduate students who possess a fervent passion for [领域] are warmly encouraged to sign up.
The selection process comprises two consecutive rounds: a preliminary written screening and an oral demonstration.
Detailed submission guidelines, including paper formats and performance criteria, are accessible on our official university portal.
closing_patterns: Anyone interested in participating is requested to submit their application to [邮箱/地点] prior to [截止日期].
Should you have any inquiries or require further information, please feel free to reach out to us at [联系方式].
Come and join us to showcase your distinctive talent and win lucrative rewards!

memo.name: 备忘录 (Memorandum / Memo)
memo.format_features: 顶格四项抬头：TO (收件人), FROM (发件人), DATE (日期), SUBJECT (事由)；正文开门见山陈述现状问题；条目化列出改进举措；末尾规定反馈期限
memo.header_template:
TO: All Project Team Members
FROM: Li Ming, Project Coordinator
DATE: October 10th, 2026
SUBJECT: Measures to Enhance Research Efficiency
opening_patterns: This memorandum serves to summarize our recent evaluation regarding [问题/现状] and propose urgent action plans.
The purpose of this memo is to address several operational inefficiencies identified during the preliminary stage of [项目名称].
body_patterns: In accordance with our latest assessment, the following corrective measures are to be implemented immediately:
First and foremost, a weekly milestone review will be instituted to ensure transparent communication across departments.
Furthermore, all documentation must be standardized and archived in the shared digital repository by Friday afternoon.
closing_patterns: Your strict compliance with the aforementioned procedures will be greatly appreciated.
Please review the attached schedule and communicate any operational concerns to my office by 5:00 PM tomorrow.

proposal.name: 倡议书与公开信 (Proposal / Open Letter)
proposal.format_features: 面向全体师生或公众的号召性文体；称呼多为 Dear Fellow Students / Dear Friends；首段点明倡议背景；中段列出2-3条具体践行规范；尾段发出强有力的共同行动号召
opening_patterns: In a concerted bid to [倡议目标，如: build a greener campus / foster academic integrity], we hereby launch this proposal to all fellow students.
With a view to promoting [文明倡议主题], I am writing this open letter on behalf of [协会/学生会] to advocate collective action.
body_patterns: To translate this noble initiative into everyday reality, it is strongly recommended that we adhere to the following principles:
To begin with, let us consciously cultivate the habit of [举措一，如: turning off idle lights and sorting daily garbage].
In addition, we ought to exercise mutual supervision and politely remind peers whenever wasteful practices occur.
closing_patterns: Small deeds, when multiplied by thousands of individuals, can trigger monumental transformations.
Let us join hands without hesitation to make our beloved campus a cleaner, warmer, and more inspiring home!

recommendation_letter.name: 推荐信 (Letter of Recommendation)
recommendation_letter.format_features: 称呼 Dear Professor... / Dear Mr. Smith；首段开宗明义推荐某人/某书/某地；中段从人品、学识、能力或特色等多角度展开详实论据；尾段极力推荐并表达愿意提供补充信息
opening_patterns: I am writing this letter with unreserved pleasure to recommend [人名/事物] for your esteemed [项目/职位/阅读计划].
Having worked closely with [人名] over the past three academic years, I have no doubt that he is an outstanding candidate for [机会].
body_patterns: What impresses me most about [人名] is his exceptional academic curiosity coupled with relentless diligence.
Not only does he exhibit profound mastery in theoretical foundations, but he also possesses stellar teamwork and problem-solving abilities.
As for this classic masterpiece, it weaves philosophical insight with exquisite literary eloquence, offering readers an unforgettable intellectual feast.
closing_patterns: Therefore, I recommend him to you with the utmost confidence, believing that he will surpass all expectations in your program.
Please feel free to contact me should you require any additional references or background materials.

suggestion_letter.name: 建议信 (Letter of Suggestion / Advice)
suggestion_letter.format_features: 语气谦逊诚恳、措辞委婉得体；首段说明写信目的并肯定既有成果；中段使用 It would be advisable to... 等虚拟或委婉句提出2-3条建设性意见；尾段期盼考虑并致谢
opening_patterns: I am writing this letter to share a few humble suggestions regarding [主题，如: library management / freshman orientation].
While sincerely applauding the tremendous efforts made by your department, I would like to venture several constructive recommendations to further optimize [项目].
body_patterns: In the first place, it would be highly advisable to extend the weekend opening hours so as to accommodate working students' study needs.
In the second place, consideration could perhaps be given to establishing an online reservation system to streamline the queuing process.
Last but not least, organizing periodic feedback forums would prove immensely beneficial in bridging the gap between staff and students.
closing_patterns: I would be more than delighted if my modest suggestions could be taken into thoughtful consideration.
Thank you for your valuable time and enduring dedication to improving our student community.
